Lam.5.1.bsb: Remember, O LORD, what has happened to us. Look and see our disgrace!
Lam.5.1.kjv: Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.

Lam.2.14.bsb: The visions of your prophets were empty and deceptive; they did not expose your guilt to ward off your captivity. The burdens they envisioned for you were empty and misleading.
Lam.2.14.kjv: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.

Lam.2.15.bsb: All who pass by clap their hands at you in scorn. They hiss and shake their heads at the Daughter of Jerusalem: “Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty, the joy of all the earth?”
Lam.2.15.kjv: All that pass by clap their hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?

Lam.4.7.bsb: Her dignitaries were brighter than snow, whiter than milk; their bodies were more ruddy than rubies, their appearance like sapphires.
Lam.4.7.kjv: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:

Lam.3.41.bsb: Let us lift up our hearts and hands to God in heaven:
Lam.3.41.kjv: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.

Lam.2.19.bsb: Arise, cry out in the night from the first watch of the night. Pour out your heart like water in the presence of the Lord. Lift up your hands to Him for the lives of your children who are fainting from hunger on the corner of every street.
Lam.2.19.kjv: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.

Lam.3.55.bsb: I called on Your name, O LORD, out of the depths of the Pit.
Lam.3.55.kjv: I called upon thy name, O Lord, out of the low dungeon.

Lam.3.56.bsb: You heard my plea: “Do not ignore my cry for relief.”
Lam.3.56.kjv: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

Lam.2.9.bsb: Her gates have sunk into the ground; He has destroyed and shattered their bars. Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations, the law is no more, and even her prophets find no vision from the LORD.
Lam.2.9.kjv: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes are among the Gentiles: the law is no more; her prophets also find no vision from the Lord.

Lam.4.10.bsb: The hands of compassionate women have cooked their own children, who became their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
Lam.4.10.kjv: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

Lam.1.4.bsb: The roads to Zion mourn, because no one comes to her appointed feasts. All her gates are deserted; her priests groan, her maidens grieve, and she herself is bitter with anguish.
Lam.1.4.kjv: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.

Lam.1.18.bsb: The LORD is righteous, yet I rebelled against His command. Listen, all you people; look upon my suffering. My young men and maidens have gone into captivity.
Lam.1.18.kjv: The Lord is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.

Lam.2.21.bsb: Both young and old lie together in the dust of the streets. My young men and maidens have fallen by the sword. You have slain them in the day of Your anger; You have slaughtered them without compassion.
Lam.2.21.kjv: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, and not pitied.

Lam.5.11.bsb: Women have been ravished in Zion, virgins in the cities of Judah.
Lam.5.11.kjv: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.

Lam.2.1.bsb: How the Lord has covered the Daughter of Zion with the cloud of His anger! He has cast the glory of Israel from heaven to earth. He has abandoned His footstool in the day of His anger.
Lam.2.1.kjv: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!

Lam.2.3.bsb: In fierce anger He has cut off every horn of Israel and withdrawn His right hand at the approach of the enemy. He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes everything around it.
Lam.2.3.kjv: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devoureth round about.

Lam.2.6.bsb: He has laid waste His tabernacle like a garden booth; He has destroyed His place of meeting. The LORD has made Zion forget her appointed feasts and Sabbaths. In His fierce anger He has despised both king and priest.
Lam.2.6.kjv: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the Lord hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.

Lam.4.11.bsb: The LORD has exhausted His wrath; He has poured out His fierce anger; He has kindled a fire in Zion, and it has consumed her foundations.
Lam.4.11.kjv: The Lord hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.

Lam.5.12.bsb: Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders receive no respect.
Lam.5.12.kjv: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.

Lam.5.13.bsb: Young men toil at millstones; boys stagger under loads of wood.
Lam.5.13.kjv: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.

Lam.3.27.bsb: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is still young.
Lam.3.27.kjv: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

Lam.2.7.bsb: The Lord has rejected His altar; He has abandoned His sanctuary; He has delivered the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy. They have raised a shout in the house of the LORD as on the day of an appointed feast.
Lam.2.7.kjv: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the Lord, as in the day of a solemn feast.

Lam.2.20.bsb: Look, O LORD, and consider: Whom have You ever treated like this? Should women eat their offspring, the infants they have nurtured? Should priests and prophets be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?
Lam.2.20.kjv: Behold, O Lord, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?

Lam.4.1.bsb: How the gold has become tarnished, the pure gold has become dull! The gems of the temple lie scattered on every street corner.
Lam.4.1.kjv: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.

Lam.2.11.bsb: My eyes fail from weeping; I am churning within. My heart is poured out in grief over the destruction of the daughter of my people, because children and infants faint in the streets of the city.
Lam.2.11.kjv: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.

Lam.3.48.bsb: Streams of tears flow from my eyes over the destruction of the daughter of my people.
Lam.3.48.kjv: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

Lam.3.49.bsb: My eyes overflow unceasingly, without relief,
Lam.3.49.kjv: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

Lam.3.50.bsb: until the LORD looks down from heaven and sees.
Lam.3.50.kjv: Till the Lord look down, and behold from heaven.

Lam.3.51.bsb: My eyes bring grief to my soul because of all the daughters of my city.
Lam.3.51.kjv: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.

Lam.5.6.bsb: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.
Lam.5.6.kjv: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

Lam.1.19.bsb: I called out to my lovers, but they have betrayed me. My priests and elders perished in the city while they searched for food to keep themselves alive.
Lam.1.19.kjv: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.

Lam.3.24.bsb: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in Him.”
Lam.3.24.kjv: The Lord is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

Lam.3.25.bsb: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
Lam.3.25.kjv: The Lord is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

Lam.3.26.bsb: It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.
Lam.3.26.kjv: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the Lord.

Lam.3.28.bsb: Let him sit alone in silence, for the LORD has laid it upon him.
Lam.3.28.kjv: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.

Lam.3.29.bsb: Let him bury his face in the dust—perhaps there is still hope.
Lam.3.29.kjv: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.

Lam.3.30.bsb: Let him offer his cheek to the one who would strike him; let him be filled with reproach.
Lam.3.30.kjv: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.

Lam.3.31.bsb: For the Lord will not cast us off forever.
Lam.3.31.kjv: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:

Lam.3.32.bsb: Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion according to His abundant loving devotion.
Lam.3.32.kjv: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.

Lam.5.19.bsb: You, O LORD, reign forever; Your throne endures from generation to generation.
Lam.5.19.kjv: Thou, O Lord, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.

Lam.3.23.bsb: They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
Lam.3.23.kjv: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

Lam.3.38.bsb: Do not both adversity and good come from the mouth of the Most High?
Lam.3.38.kjv: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?

Lam.3.22.bsb: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
Lam.3.22.kjv: It is of the Lord’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

Lam.3.33.bsb: For He does not willingly afflict or grieve the sons of men.
Lam.3.33.kjv: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.

Lam.3.52.bsb: Without cause my enemies hunted me like a bird.
Lam.3.52.kjv: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.

Lam.3.53.bsb: They dropped me alive into a pit and cast stones upon me.
Lam.3.53.kjv: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.

Lam.3.54.bsb: The waters flowed over my head, and I thought I was going to die.
Lam.3.54.kjv: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.

Lam.3.57.bsb: You drew near when I called on You; You said, “Do not be afraid.”
Lam.3.57.kjv: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.

Lam.3.58.bsb: You defend my cause, O Lord; You redeem my life.
Lam.3.58.kjv: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

Lam.3.34.bsb: To crush underfoot all the prisoners of the land,
Lam.3.34.kjv: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

Lam.3.36.bsb: to subvert a man in his lawsuit—of these the Lord does not approve.
Lam.3.36.kjv: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.

Lam.3.37.bsb: Who has spoken and it came to pass, unless the Lord has ordained it?
Lam.3.37.kjv: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?

Lam.5.14.bsb: The elders have left the city gate; the young men have stopped their music.
Lam.5.14.kjv: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.

Lam.4.3.bsb: Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young, but the daughter of my people has become cruel, like an ostrich in the wilderness.
Lam.4.3.kjv: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

Lam.4.4.bsb: The nursing infant’s tongue clings in thirst to the roof of his mouth. Little children beg for bread, but no one gives them any.
Lam.4.4.kjv: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.

Lam.5.3.bsb: We have become fatherless orphans; our mothers are widows.
Lam.5.3.kjv: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.

Lam.5.7.bsb: Our fathers sinned and are no more, but we bear their punishment.
Lam.5.7.kjv: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.

Lam.1.22.bsb: Let all their wickedness come before You, and deal with them as You have dealt with me because of all my transgressions. For my groans are many, and my heart is faint.
Lam.1.22.kjv: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.

Lam.3.64.bsb: You will pay them back what they deserve, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
Lam.3.64.kjv: Render unto them a recompence, O Lord, according to the work of their hands.

Lam.3.65.bsb: Put a veil of anguish over their hearts; may Your curse be upon them!
Lam.3.65.kjv: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.

Lam.3.66.bsb: You will pursue them in anger and exterminate them from under Your heavens, O LORD.
Lam.3.66.kjv: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the Lord.

Lam.3.42.bsb: “We have sinned and rebelled; You have not forgiven.”
Lam.3.42.kjv: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.

Lam.5.16.bsb: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
Lam.5.16.kjv: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!

Lam.3.59.bsb: You have seen, O LORD, the wrong done to me; vindicate my cause!
Lam.3.59.kjv: O Lord, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.

Lam.3.60.bsb: You have seen all their malice, all their plots against me.
Lam.3.60.kjv: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.

Lam.3.61.bsb: O LORD, You have heard their insults, all their plots against me—
Lam.3.61.kjv: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Lord, and all their imaginations against me;

Lam.3.62.bsb: the slander and murmuring of my assailants against me all day long.
Lam.3.62.kjv: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

Lam.3.63.bsb: When they sit and when they rise, see how they mock me in song.
Lam.3.63.kjv: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.

Lam.3.40.bsb: Let us examine and test our ways, and turn back to the LORD.
Lam.3.40.kjv: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the Lord.

Lam.4.2.bsb: How the precious sons of Zion, once worth their weight in pure gold, are now esteemed as jars of clay, the work of a potter’s hands!
Lam.4.2.kjv: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

Lam.5.8.bsb: Slaves rule over us; there is no one to deliver us from their hands.
Lam.5.8.kjv: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.

Lam.1.20.bsb: See, O LORD, how distressed I am! I am churning within; my heart is pounding within me, for I have been most rebellious. Outside, the sword bereaves; inside, there is death.
Lam.1.20.kjv: Behold, O Lord; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.

Lam.1.3.bsb: Judah has gone into exile under affliction and harsh slavery; she dwells among the nations but finds no place to rest. All her pursuers have overtaken her in the midst of her distress.
Lam.1.3.kjv: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.

Lam.1.8.bsb: Jerusalem has sinned greatly; therefore she has become an object of scorn. All who honored her now despise her, for they have seen her nakedness; she herself groans and turns away.
Lam.1.8.kjv: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.

Lam.1.14.bsb: My transgressions are bound into a yoke, knit together by His hand; they are draped over my neck, and the Lord has broken my strength. He has delivered me into the hands of those I cannot withstand.
Lam.1.14.kjv: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, and come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the Lord hath delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.

Lam.4.6.bsb: The punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was overthrown in an instant without a hand turned to help her.
Lam.4.6.kjv: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.

Lam.1.10.bsb: The adversary has seized all her treasures. For she has seen the nations enter her sanctuary—those You had forbidden to enter Your assembly.
Lam.1.10.kjv: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.

Lam.2.10.bsb: The elders of the Daughter of Zion sit on the ground in silence. They have thrown dust on their heads and put on sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.
Lam.2.10.kjv: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
